title: Ending Round 8 Picks
eyebrow: GPOM · E the ending · timeline round 8
heading: The phone shows D's last shot, and a new Parliament
intro: Two picks. 1) Her phone in E01 and E02 now shows D's real last shot (D16n: the empty seated room, small clean Maddie). Flow couldn't paint that exact framing at phone size, so I placed D's actual frame on the screen in the still (her thumbs stay in front), and once you pick, Flow animates the shot from it, so the glow and glare come from the camera. 2) Parliament: four new shots, more real and more dramatic. Pick one per row; I then animate the three picks (Omni 1.2, a few video credits) and cut round 8 with your other notes (E01 to 5 s, the bank sign, the rain tail).

sections.lede: Click to enlarge and look at the screen. The first image in the E01 row is D's last frame, for comparison.
